description: This file implements credential storage management, including parsing, storing, removing, and retrieving credentials from files. It provides functionalities to handle credential files securely with locking mechanisms and URL encoding.

methods.name: int parse_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c,void (* match_cb)(struct credential *),void (* other_cb)(struct strbuf *),int match_password)
methods.description: Reads and parses credential entries from a file, calling callback functions on matches or other lines.

methods.name: void print_entry(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Prints the username and password of a credential entry.

methods.name: void print_line(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Write a line buffer to the credential file with proper locking.

methods.name: void rewrite_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c,struct strbuf * extra,int match_password)
methods.description: Rewrites the credential file with optional extra content, handling locking and timeout.

methods.name: int is_rfc3986_unreserved(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is an unreserved symbol per RFC 3986.

methods.name: int is_rfc3986_reserved_or_unreserved(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is reserved or unreserved in RFC 3986.

methods.name: void store_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Serializes and stores credential data into a file path, URL-encoding components.

methods.name: void store_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores credentials into one of the specified files after validation.

methods.name: void remove_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Removes credentials matching the input from specified files.

methods.name: void lookup_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Searches for matching credentials across files and prints the credential if found.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_store(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command handler for credential store operations: get, store, erase based on input arguments.

ctags.name: cmd_credential_store
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: lookup_credential
ctags.pattern: /^static void lookup_credential(const struct string_list *fns, struct credential *c)$/

ctags.name: parse_credential_file
ctags.signature: (const char * fn,struct credential * c,void (* match_cb)(struct credential *),void (* other_cb)(struct strbuf *),int match_password)

ctags.name: remove_credential
ctags.pattern: /^static void remove_credential(const struct string_list *fns, struct credential *c)$/

ctags.name: rewrite_credential_file
ctags.signature: (const char * fn,struct credential * c,struct strbuf * extra,int match_password)

ctags.name: store_credential
ctags.pattern: /^static void store_credential(const struct string_list *fns, struct credential *c)$/
